name: session_snapshot
description: Retrieve the full current state of the Bitwig Studio session. Returns transport state (playing, tempo, position, metronomeVolume, preRoll), all tracks (name, volume, pan, mute, solo, arm, isMutedBySolo, sends, crossfadeMode, monitorMode, trackType, isGroup, isGroupExpanded, canHoldNoteData, canHoldAudioData), master track (volume, pan, mute, solo, color), project state (hasSoloedTracks, hasMutedTracks, hasArmedTracks, isModified, panelLayout), clip grid (64 tracks x 8 slots with content, playback, and recording states), scenes, device state (cursor track, cursor device, remote control parameters with hasAutomation flag, nesting info: isNested, hasSlots, slotNames, hasLayers, hasDrumPads), masterDevice state (master bus device chain, parameters, nesting info), application state (project name, undo/redo), arranger state (7 visibility toggles), arrangement state (loop range, punch in/out, automation mode, cue markers), browser state (exists, title, selectedContentType, contentTypeNames, canAudition, shouldAudition, resultName, resultIsSelected, resultsEntryCount, filters with 8 columns: category/tag/creator/device/deviceType/fileType/location/smartCollection each with exists/name/hitCount/entryCount), arpeggiator state (isEnabled, mode, octaves, rate, gateLength, shuffle, humanize, isFreeRunning, enableOverlappingNotes, usePressureToVelocity, terminateNotesImmediately), noteLatch state (isEnabled, mode, mono, velocityThreshold, activeNotes), and groove state (enabled, shuffleAmount, shuffleRate, accentAmount, accentRate, accentPhase). Always call this before taking actions to understand the current state, and after actions to verify results.

name: api_list
description: List all available JSON-RPC methods registered in the Secondo extension. Returns an array of method name strings. Useful for discovering available capabilities.

name: transport_play
description: Start playback in Bitwig Studio. If already playing, this has no effect.

name: transport_stop
description: Stop playback in Bitwig Studio. If already stopped, this has no effect.

name: transport_record
description: Toggle recording in Bitwig Studio. Arms the arranger record button.

name: transport_togglePlay
description: Toggle between play and stop states. If playing, stops; if stopped, plays.

name: transport_rewind
description: Rewind the transport position. Moves the playhead backward.

name: transport_fastForward
description: Fast-forward the transport position. Moves the playhead forward.

name: transport_tapTempo
description: Tap tempo. Each call registers a tap; Bitwig calculates the tempo from the tap interval.

name: transport_setTempo
description: Set the project tempo in BPM. Value is raw BPM (e.g., 120.0 for 120 BPM), not normalized.

tempo.description: Tempo in BPM (e.g., 120.0). Raw value, not normalized.

name: transport_setPosition
description: Set the transport playhead position in beats. Beat 0.0 is the project start.

beats.description: Position in beats from project start (e.g., 4.0 for beat 5, since 0-based).

name: transport_setLoop
description: Enable or disable the arranger loop in Bitwig Studio.

enabled.description: True to enable looping, false to disable.

name: transport_setMetronome
description: Enable or disable the metronome click in Bitwig Studio.

enabled.description: True to enable the metronome, false to disable.

name: app_undo
description: Undo the last action in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_redo
description: Redo the last undone action in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_getState
description: Get application state including the project name, and whether undo/redo are available. Returns an object with projectName, canUndo, canRedo, and hasActiveEngine.

name: track_setVolume
description: Set the volume of a track in the track bank. Volume is normalized 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = -inf dB, 1.0 = max).

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

name: track_setPan
description: Set the pan of a track in the track bank. Pan is normalized 0.0 (full left) to 1.0 (full right), with 0.5 as center.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

value.description: Pan position, normalized 0.0 (left) to 1.0 (right). 0.5 is center.

name: track_setMute
description: Mute or unmute a track in the track bank.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

muted.description: True to mute the track, false to unmute.

name: track_setSolo
description: Solo or unsolo a track in the track bank.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

soloed.description: True to solo the track, false to unsolo.

name: track_setArm
description: Arm or disarm a track for recording in the track bank.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

armed.description: True to arm the track for recording, false to disarm.

name: track_setColor
description: Set the color of a track in the track bank. Color is RGB floats 0.0 to 1.0.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: track_setCrossfade
description: Set the crossfade mode of a track. Used for clip launcher A/B crossfading.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

mode.description: Crossfade assignment: 'A' (crossfader side A), 'B' (side B), or 'AB' (both/unassigned).

name: track_setMonitor
description: Set the input monitoring mode of a track. Controls when audio input is monitored.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

mode.description: Monitor mode: 'ON' (always monitor input), 'OFF' (never monitor), 'AUTO' (monitor when armed).

name: master_setVolume
description: Set the master track volume. Volume is normalized 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = -inf dB, 1.0 = max).

name: master_setPan
description: Set the master track pan. Pan is normalized 0.0 (full left) to 1.0 (full right), with 0.5 as center.

value.description: Pan position, normalized 0.0 (left) to 1.0 (right). 0.5 is center.

name: master_setMute
description: Mute or unmute the master track.

value.description: True to mute, false to unmute.

name: master_setSolo
description: Solo or unsolo the master track.

value.description: True to solo, false to unsolo.

name: master_setColor
description: Set the color of the master track. Color is RGB floats 0.0 to 1.0.

name: masterDevice_selectNext
description: Select the next device in the master track's device chain. Moves the master device cursor forward.

name: masterDevice_selectPrevious
description: Select the previous device in the master track's device chain. Moves the master device cursor backward.

name: masterDevice_nextPreset
description: Switch to the next preset on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_previousPreset
description: Switch to the previous preset on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_nextPresetCategory
description: Jump to the next preset category on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_previousPresetCategory
description: Jump to the previous preset category on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_nextPresetCreator
description: Jump to the next preset creator on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_previousPresetCreator
description: Jump to the previous preset creator on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable (bypass) the currently selected device on the master track.

enabled.description: true to enable the device, false to bypass it.

name: masterDevice_insertBitwigDevice
description: Insert a built-in Bitwig device onto the master track by name. The name is resolved case-insensitively from the Bitwig device library. Use `device_listBitwigDevices` to discover available devices. Common master bus devices: EQ-5, Compressor, Peak Limiter, Dynamics.

position.description: Where to insert: "end" = end of chain (default), "before" = before master cursor device, "after" = after master cursor device.

name: masterDevice_insertPluginDevice
description: Insert a third-party plugin (VST2, VST3, or CLAP) onto the master track. You must know the plugin ID.

id.description: Plugin ID. VST2: integer as string. VST3/CLAP: string ID.

position.description: Where to insert: "end" = end of chain (default), "before" = before master cursor device, "after" = after master cursor device.

name: masterDevice_remove
description: Remove the currently selected device from the master track's device chain.

name: masterDevice_selectPage
description: Select a remote controls parameter page by index on the currently selected master device.

index.description: Page index (0-based).

name: masterDevice_nextPage
description: Select the next remote controls parameter page on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_previousPage
description: Select the previous remote controls parameter page on the currently selected master device.

name: masterDevice_setParameterValue
description: Set a remote control parameter value on the currently selected master device's current parameter page. Value is normalized 0.0 to 1.0.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: masterDevice_setParameters
description: Set multiple parameters across multiple pages on the master track device in one batch call. Navigates pages and sets parameter values using TaskScheduler for cross-flush-cycle execution. First page is applied immediately, subsequent pages are scheduled at 100ms intervals. Use this for creating sounds from scratch — set all parameters in one call instead of 20+ sequential setParameterValue calls.

pages.description: Array of page objects, each with pageIndex and params to set on that page.

params.description: Parameters to set on this page.

index.description: Parameter index within the page (0-7).

name: masterDevice_enterSlot
description: Navigate into a nested device chain (slot) of the current master bus device. Check masterDevice snapshot hasSlots and slotNames before calling. After entering, the masterDevice cursor points to the first device inside that slot.

name.description: The slot name to enter (from masterDevice snapshot slotNames array).

name: masterDevice_exitToParent
description: Navigate out of a nested device chain back to the parent device on the master bus. Check masterDevice snapshot isNested — only call when isNested is true.

name: send_setLevel
description: Set the send level (amount) for a specific send on a track. Routes audio to the corresponding effect/return track.

name: send_setMode
description: Set the send mode (pre-fader, post-fader, or auto) for a specific send on a track.

name: send_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable a specific send on a track.

enabled.description: True to enable the send, false to disable.

name: clip_launch
description: Launch a clip in the clip launcher. The clip at the specified track and slot index will start playing. Optionally override launch quantization and mode for this specific launch. Note: this starts the transport if it is currently stopped.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

quantization.description: Override launch quantization for this launch. Must be provided together with launchMode.

launchMode.description: Override launch mode for this launch. Must be provided together with quantization.

name: clip_stop
description: Stop all clips on a track. Stops any playing or recording clip on the specified track.

name: clip_record
description: Start recording into a clip slot. The track should be armed for recording first.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_create
description: Create an empty clip in a clip launcher slot. The clip will have the specified length in beats and can then be launched or recorded into.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

lengthInBeats.description: Length of the new clip in beats (e.g., 4 for one bar at 4/4).

name: scene_launch
description: Launch a scene in the clip launcher. Triggers all clips in the scene row across all tracks. Optionally override launch quantization and mode for this specific launch.

index.description: Scene index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

quantization.description: Override launch quantization for this launch. Must be provided together with launchMode.

launchMode.description: Override launch mode for this launch. Must be provided together with quantization.

name: device_selectNext
description: Select the next device in the current track's device chain. The cursor device moves to the next device.

name: device_selectPrevious
description: Select the previous device in the current track's device chain. The cursor device moves to the previous device.

name: device_nextPreset
description: Switch to the next preset on the currently selected device. Use for quick preset auditioning during sound design.

name: device_previousPreset
description: Switch to the previous preset on the currently selected device.

name: device_nextPresetCategory
description: Jump to the next preset category on the currently selected device. Categories group presets by type (Bass, Lead, Pad, Keys, etc.).

name: device_previousPresetCategory
description: Jump to the previous preset category on the currently selected device.

name: device_nextPresetCreator
description: Jump to the next preset creator (author/vendor) on the currently selected device.

name: device_previousPresetCreator
description: Jump to the previous preset creator (author/vendor) on the currently selected device.

name: device_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable (bypass) the currently selected device.

enabled.description: True to enable the device, false to bypass it.

name: device_selectPage
description: Select a specific remote controls parameter page by index on the currently selected device.

index.description: Parameter page index (0-based). Check session_snapshot for pageCount.

name: device_nextPage
description: Navigate to the next remote controls parameter page on the currently selected device.

name: device_previousPage
description: Navigate to the previous remote controls parameter page on the currently selected device.

name: device_setParameterValue
description: Set a remote control parameter value on the currently selected device's current parameter page. Value is normalized 0.0 to 1.0.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: device_setParameters
description: Set multiple parameters across multiple pages in one batch call. Navigates pages and sets parameter values using TaskScheduler for cross-flush-cycle execution. First page is applied immediately, subsequent pages are scheduled at 100ms intervals. Use this for creating sounds from scratch — set all parameters in one call instead of 20+ sequential setParameterValue calls.

pages.description: Array of page objects, each with pageIndex and params to set on that page.

params.description: Parameters to set on this page.

index.description: Parameter index within the page (0-7).

name: device_hasAutomation
description: Check whether a remote control parameter on the current device page has automation data recorded in the arranger. Returns {hasAutomation: boolean}.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: device_deleteAllAutomation
description: Delete all automation data for a remote control parameter on the current device page. This removes the entire automation envelope from the arranger. Use `device_hasAutomation` first to check before deleting.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: device_restoreAutomationControl
description: Restore a parameter to its automation curve after it has been manually overridden. When a parameter is changed during playback, it overrides automation until this is called or `transport_resetAutomationOverrides` clears all overrides globally.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: device_touch
description: Touch or untouch a remote control parameter for automation recording. When touched during playback with automation write enabled, parameter value changes are recorded to the automation lane. Always untouch after recording to stop capturing changes. WARNING: Forgetting to untouch leaves the parameter in recording mode.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

touched.description: True to enter touch/recording mode, false to exit.

name: device_writeEnvelope
description: Write an automation envelope curve for a remote control parameter. Takes an array of {position, value} points and records them as automation data in the arranger. Internally uses simulated touch recording with playback — returns immediately but recording completes asynchronously (~100ms per point). PREREQUISITES: (1) Arranger automation write must be enabled via `transport_setArrangerAutomationWrite`. (2) Automation write mode should be set (e.g., 'touch' via `transport_setAutomationWriteMode`). Transport position and play/stop state are saved and restored after recording. Points are sorted by position, values clamped to [0,1], duplicate positions use last-wins.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

points.description: Array of automation points to write. Points are sorted by position automatically.

position.description: Beat position in the arranger (must be >= 0).

value.description: Parameter value, normalized 0.0 to 1.0. Values outside this range are clamped.

name: cursor_selectTrack
description: Navigate the cursor track selection to the next or previous track sequentially. The cursor track follows the UI selection and determines which track's devices are shown. For direct index access, use `track_select` instead.

direction.description: Direction to move the cursor: 'next' for the track below, 'previous' for the track above.

name: clip_delete
description: Delete a clip from a clip launcher slot. Removes the clip and its contents entirely.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_select
description: Select a clip slot for note editing. The cursor clip will follow this selection, making it the target for setNotes, getNotes, clearNote, and clearAllNotes. Must be called before editing notes in a specific clip. IMPORTANT: Cursor movement is async — after selecting, wait 1-2 seconds before calling getNotes to allow step data to load. Writing (setNotes) uses deferred scheduling and is not affected.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_setNotes
description: Write multiple notes into the selected clip in a single batch operation. Each note is placed at a grid position (x=step, y=MIDI note). Existing notes at the same positions are overwritten. Use this to write entire patterns, chords, basslines, or drum sequences in one call.

notes.description: Array of notes to write. Each note has x (step position), y (MIDI note number), velocity (0.0-1.0, optional, default ~0.79), and duration (in beats, optional, default 0.25). To set note probability, use clip_setChance after writing notes (chance requires a separate call due to Bitwig's flush cycle).

x.description: Step position in the grid (0-based). At 1/16 resolution: 0-15 = bar 1, 16-31 = bar 2, etc.

y.description: MIDI note number (0-127). Common values: 36=C2 (kick), 38=D2 (snare), 42=F#2 (hi-hat), 60=C4 (middle C).

velocity.description: Note velocity, 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (maximum). Optional, defaults to ~0.79.

duration.description: Note duration in beats. 0.25 = 1/16 note, 0.5 = 1/8 note, 1.0 = 1/4 note. Optional, defaults to 0.25.

name: clip_clearNote
description: Remove a single note at the specified grid position in the selected clip.

name: clip_clearAllNotes
description: Remove all notes from the selected clip. This clears the entire clip content.

name: clip_getNotes
description: Read all notes in the selected clip's current grid viewport. Returns a sparse array containing only cells with notes (NoteOn state). Each note includes x (step), y (MIDI note), velocity (0.0-1.0), duration (beats), and expressive properties when non-default: pan (-1..1), timbre (-1..1), pressure (0..1), gain (0..1, 0.5=0dB), transpose (-96..+96 semitones), releaseVelocity (0..1), velocitySpread (0..1), mute (boolean), chance (0..1), occurrence (NoteOccurrence enum string), recurrence ({length, mask}), repeat ({count, curve, velocityEnd, velocityCurve}). IMPORTANT: After clip/select, wait 1-2 seconds before calling this — the cursor clip loads step data asynchronously, and reading too soon returns empty or stale results.

name: clip_setChance
description: Set the probability (chance) for existing notes in the selected clip. Notes must already exist — call clip_setNotes first, then clip_setChance. Each entry specifies the step position (x, y) and the chance value. When chance is enabled, the note only plays with the given probability on each loop iteration.

notes.description: Array of note positions with chance values.

x.description: Step position of the existing note.

y.description: MIDI note number of the existing note.

chance.description: Probability the note plays (0.0 to 1.0). 0.5 = 50% chance, 1.0 = always plays.

name: clip_setNoteExpressions
description: Set expressive properties on existing notes in the selected clip. Batch-set scalar note properties like pan, timbre, pressure, gain, transpose, releaseVelocity, velocitySpread, or mute. Each entry targets a specific note by step position (x, y) and sets one property at a time. Notes must already exist. Call after clip_setNotes.

x.description: Step position of the existing note.

y.description: MIDI note number of the existing note.

property.description: Property to set. One of: pan (-1..1), timbre (-1..1), pressure (0..1), gain (0..1, 0.5=0dB), transpose (-96..+96), releaseVelocity (0..1), velocitySpread (0..1), mute (0=unmute, non-zero=mute).

value.description: Value to set for the property. Range depends on property.

name: clip_setNoteRepeat
description: Set note repeat (note echo/ratchet) properties on existing notes. Enables repeat and sets all 4 sub-properties together. Repeat creates rhythmic subdivisions of a note — positive count = divisions, negative count = rate. Notes must already exist.

notes.description: Array of notes with repeat settings.

x.description: Step position of the existing note.

y.description: MIDI note number of the existing note.

count.description: Repeat count (-127..127). Positive = number of divisions, negative = rate.

curve.description: Timing curve (-1..1). 0 = linear, negative = accelerating, positive = decelerating.

velocityEnd.description: Velocity change over repeats (-1..1). Relative amount applied to note velocity.

velocityCurve.description: Velocity curve shape (-1..1). 0 = linear velocity change.

name: clip_setNoteOccurrence
description: Set occurrence conditions on existing notes. Occurrence controls when a note plays based on context: whether it's the first time, whether previous notes were playing, fill mode, etc. Notes must already exist.

notes.description: Array of notes with occurrence conditions.

x.description: Step position of the existing note.

y.description: MIDI note number of the existing note.

name: clip_setNoteRecurrence
description: Set recurrence patterns on existing notes. Recurrence makes notes play only on specific iterations of a cycle (1-8 steps). The mask is a bitmask where bit N controls whether the note plays on cycle N. Example: length=4, mask=5 (binary 0101) = plays on cycles 1 and 3. Notes must already exist.

notes.description: Array of notes with recurrence patterns.

x.description: Step position of the existing note.

y.description: MIDI note number of the existing note.

mask.description: Bitmask for which cycles the note plays. Bit N = cycle N. Max 8 bits.

name: clip_setStepSize
description: Set the step grid resolution for the cursor clip. This determines the time duration of each step in the grid. Common values: 0.25 = 1/16 note (default), 0.5 = 1/8 note, 1.0 = 1/4 note, 0.125 = 1/32 note.

name: clip_scrollSteps
description: Scroll the step grid viewport to a specific step offset. The grid viewport is 64 steps wide. Use this to navigate to different sections of clips longer than 64 steps. Offset 0 = beginning, 64 = second page, etc.

offset.description: Step offset to scroll to (0-based). The viewport will show 64 steps starting from this position.

name: device_insertBitwigDevice
description: Insert a built-in Bitwig device onto the cursor track by name. The name is resolved case-insensitively from the Bitwig device library (151 devices). If the name is not found, an error is returned with close-match suggestions. Use `device_listBitwigDevices` to discover available devices first.

position.description: Where to insert: "end" = end of device chain (default), "before" = before cursor device, "after" = after cursor device.

name: device_insertPluginDevice
description: Insert a third-party plugin (VST2, VST3, or CLAP) onto the cursor track. You must know the plugin ID — VST2 uses integer IDs, VST3 and CLAP use string IDs.

id.description: Plugin ID. For VST2: integer as string (e.g., "1234567890"). For VST3/CLAP: string ID.

position.description: Where to insert: "end" = end of device chain (default), "before" = before cursor device, "after" = after cursor device.

name: device_listBitwigDevices
description: List all available built-in Bitwig devices. Returns a sorted array of device names that can be used with `device_insertBitwigDevice`. Includes instruments (Polymer, Poly Grid, FM-4, etc.), audio effects (EQ-5, Compressor, Delay-2, etc.), and note effects (Arpeggiator, Note Echo, etc.).

name: device_remove
description: Remove the currently selected device from the cursor track's device chain. Navigate to the target device first using `device_selectNext` / `device_selectPrevious`, then call this to delete it. Warning: the cursor device loses selection after removal — call `session_snapshot` to verify state. This action cannot be undone via this API (but Bitwig's undo may work).

name: device_getDrumPads
description: Returns the drum pad names and their MIDI note numbers for the currently selected device. Only works when the device has drum pads (hasDrumPads: true in snapshot). Use this to discover which MIDI note corresponds to which drum sound (e.g., kick, snare, hi-hat) before writing notes with clip_setNotes. Different drum kits map sounds to different notes — always call this first.

name: device_enterSlot
description: Navigate into a nested device chain (slot) of the current device. Check device snapshot hasSlots and slotNames before calling. After entering, the device cursor points to the first device inside that slot. Use device_exitToParent to return.

name.description: The slot name to enter (from device snapshot slotNames array).

name: device_exitToParent
description: Navigate out of a nested device chain back to the parent device. Check device snapshot isNested — only call when isNested is true. The device cursor returns to the parent container device.

name: track_createAudio
description: Create a new audio track in the project. Audio tracks can record and play audio clips. The new track is created at the specified position, or appended at the end if no position is given. The cursor track will follow the new track. Note: cursorTrackName in the response may lag — call `session_snapshot` to verify.

position.description: Insert position (0-based track index). Use -1 to append at the end (default).

name: track_createInstrument
description: Create a new instrument track in the project. Instrument tracks host virtual instruments and can record/play MIDI. The new track is created at the specified position, or appended at the end if no position is given. The cursor track will follow the new track. Note: cursorTrackName in the response may lag — call `session_snapshot` to verify.

position.description: Insert position (0-based track index). Use -1 to append at the end (default).

name: track_createEffect
description: Create a new effect track (return/bus track) in the project. Effect tracks receive audio from sends and apply effects. The new track is created at the specified position, or appended at the end if no position is given. The cursor track will follow the new track. Note: cursorTrackName in the response may lag — call `session_snapshot` to verify.

position.description: Insert position (0-based track index). Use -1 to append at the end (default).

name: track_select
description: Select a track by its bank index. The cursor track will follow this selection, making subsequent cursor-based operations (rename, delete, insert device, note editing) target the selected track. Returns { ok, trackName, trackIndex } with the bank track name (accurate immediately). IMPORTANT: Cursor movement is async — cursorTrack-dependent operations in the same flush cycle may still target the previous track.

index.description: Track index to select (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

name: track_rename
description: Rename the currently selected (cursor) track. The cursor track must be pointing at the desired track first — use `track_select` or `cursor_selectTrack` to navigate.

name: track_deleteSelected
description: Delete the currently selected (cursor) track from the project. This permanently removes the track and all its clips, devices, and automation. The cursor track must be pointing at the track to delete. Use `track_select` to target a specific track first.

name: track_duplicate
description: Duplicate the currently selected (cursor) track. Creates a copy of the track with all its clips, devices, and settings. The cursor track must be pointing at the track to duplicate.

name: track_setGroupExpanded
description: Expand or collapse the currently selected group track. The cursor track must be pointing at a group track. Use 'expanded' to set a specific state, or 'toggle' to flip the current state. Provide exactly one parameter.

expanded.description: True to expand the group, false to collapse it.

toggle.description: Set to true to toggle the current expanded/collapsed state.

name: track_navigateInto
description: Navigate into the currently selected group track. Makes the group's child tracks visible as top-level tracks in the track bank. Use track/navigateToParent to go back up. The cursor track must be pointing at a group track.

name: track_navigateToParent
description: Navigate out of the current group track to the parent level. Reverses the effect of track/navigateInto. If already at the top level, this has no effect.

name: track_createGroup
description: Create a new group track that wraps the currently selected track. The selected track becomes a child of the new group. The cursor track must be pointing at the track to group.

name: track_addNoteSource
description: Route the extension's NoteInput to the currently selected track. After calling this, noteInput/sendNote and noteInput/sendMidi will play through this track's instrument. Useful for targeting real-time MIDI playback to a specific track.

name: track_removeNoteSource
description: Remove the NoteInput routing from the currently selected track. Stops the extension's NoteInput from playing through this track. Use after track/addNoteSource when done with targeted playback.

name: arranger_setPlaybackFollow
description: Enable or disable playback follow in the arranger. When enabled, the arranger view scrolls to follow the playhead during playback.

enabled.description: True to enable playback follow, false to disable.

name: arranger_setClipLauncherVisible
description: Show or hide the clip launcher panel in the arranger view.

enabled.description: True to show the clip launcher, false to hide.

name: arranger_setTimelineVisible
description: Show or hide the arranger timeline. The timeline displays clips arranged linearly for song composition.

enabled.description: True to show the timeline, false to hide.

name: arranger_setCueMarkersVisible
description: Show or hide cue markers in the arranger timeline. Cue markers mark positions in the arrangement (intro, verse, chorus, etc.).

enabled.description: True to show cue markers, false to hide.

name: arranger_setEffectTracksVisible
description: Show or hide effect (return/bus) tracks in the arranger view.

enabled.description: True to show effect tracks, false to hide.

name: arranger_setIoSectionVisible
description: Show or hide the I/O section in the arranger. The I/O section shows input/output routing for each track.

enabled.description: True to show the I/O section, false to hide.

name: arranger_setDoubleRowTrackHeight
description: Toggle double-row track height in the arranger. When enabled, tracks display at double height for better visibility.

enabled.description: True for double-row height, false for single-row.

name: transport_setLoopRange
description: Set the arranger loop range and enable/disable looping. Defines a loop region by start position and duration in beats (quarter notes). Use with `transport_setPosition` to position playback at loop start.

start.description: Loop start position in beats (quarter notes). 0.0 = bar 1 beat 1.

duration.description: Loop duration in beats (quarter notes). e.g. 16.0 = 4 bars in 4/4.

enabled.description: True to enable looping, false to disable.

name: transport_getLoopRange
description: Get the current loop range, punch in/out positions, and their enabled states. Returns loopStart, loopDuration, loopEnabled, punchInPosition, punchInEnabled, punchOutPosition, punchOutEnabled.

name: transport_setPunchIn
description: Set the punch-in position and enable/disable punch-in recording. When enabled, recording only starts at the punch-in position.

enabled.description: True to enable punch-in, false to disable.

name: transport_setPunchOut
description: Set the punch-out position and enable/disable punch-out recording. When enabled, recording automatically stops at the punch-out position.

enabled.description: True to enable punch-out, false to disable.

name: transport_setAutomationWriteMode
description: Set the automation write mode. Controls how parameter changes are recorded as automation. 'latch' records from first touch until stop, 'touch' records only while touching and returns to existing automation on release, 'write' overwrites all automation in the played range.

mode.description: Automation write mode: latch, touch, or write.

name: transport_setArrangerAutomationWrite
description: Enable or disable automation writing in the arranger. When enabled, parameter changes during playback are recorded as arranger automation.

enabled.description: True to enable arranger automation write, false to disable.

name: transport_setClipLauncherAutomationWrite
description: Enable or disable automation writing in the clip launcher. When enabled, parameter changes during clip playback are recorded as clip automation.

enabled.description: True to enable clip launcher automation write, false to disable.

name: transport_resetAutomationOverrides
description: Reset all automation overrides. Clears any manual parameter adjustments made during playback, returning all automated parameters to their stored automation values.

name: cueMarker_addAtPlayhead
description: Add a cue marker at the current playhead position. To place a marker at a specific beat, first use `transport_setPosition` to move the playhead, then call this. Cue markers are used to label arrangement sections (intro, verse, chorus, etc.).

name: cueMarker_list
description: List all cue markers in the 16-slot cue marker bank. Returns an array of existing markers with index, name, position (in beats), and color (RGB array). Empty slots are omitted.

name: cueMarker_launch
description: Launch playback from a cue marker position. Moves the playhead to the marker and starts playback. Use `cueMarker_list` first to find valid marker indices.

index.description: Cue marker index (0-15) from the marker bank.

quantized.description: If true, launch is quantized to the grid. If false, launches immediately. Defaults to false.

name: cueMarker_delete
description: Delete a cue marker by its bank index. Use `cueMarker_list` first to find the marker index to delete.

index.description: Cue marker index (0-15) to delete.

name: scene_create
description: Create a new empty scene at the end of the project. The scene will have no clips. Use `scene_rename` afterward to give it a name.

name: scene_createFromPlaying
description: Create a new scene from all currently playing launcher clips. Captures the current clip launcher state into a new scene row. Useful for saving a live performance moment as a reusable scene.

name: scene_duplicate
description: Duplicate a scene by its bank index. Creates a copy of the scene including all its clips. The duplicate appears after the original.

index.description: Scene index (0-7) within the current scene bank window.

name: scene_rename
description: Rename a scene by its bank index. Use `session_snapshot` to see current scene names.

index.description: Scene index (0-7) within the current scene bank window.

name: scene_delete
description: Delete a scene by its bank index. Removes the scene and all its clips. WARNING: This is destructive and cannot be undone via the API — use `application_undo` if needed.

index.description: Scene index (0-7) within the current scene bank window.

name: clip_rename
description: Rename the currently selected clip (cursor clip). You must first select the clip with `clip_select`, then call this to set its name. Useful for versioning clips (e.g., 'Verse A', 'Verse B') or labeling iterations.

name: clip_duplicate
description: Duplicate a clip in-place within its slot bank. The duplicate appears in the next available slot on the same track. Use for A/B versioning or iterating on a clip.

name: clip_duplicateToSlot
description: Copy a clip from one slot to another, replacing the destination slot's content. Works across tracks. Use for copying a pattern to a different track or scene slot.

destSlotIndex.description: Destination clip slot index (0-7). Existing content will be replaced.

name: cueMarker_rename
description: Rename a cue marker by its bank index. Use `cueMarker_list` first to find valid marker indices. Markers created with `cueMarker_addAtPlayhead` default to 'Untitled' — use this to give them meaningful names like 'Intro', 'Verse 1', 'Chorus'.

index.description: Cue marker index (0-15) from the marker bank.

name.description: New name for the cue marker.

name: cueMarker_setPosition
description: Move a cue marker to a new position in beats. Use `cueMarker_list` first to see current positions. Position is in beat time (e.g., 0.0 = bar 1, 4.0 = bar 2 in 4/4).

index.description: Cue marker index (0-15) from the marker bank.

name: cueMarker_duplicate
description: Duplicate a cue marker. Creates a copy at the same position. Use `cueMarker_setPosition` afterward to move the duplicate to a new location.

index.description: Cue marker index (0-15) to duplicate.

name: sceneBank_scrollTo
description: Scroll the scene bank to an absolute position. The position is a global scene index (not bank-relative). After scrolling, the bank window shows scenes starting from this position. Returns POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE error if position is out of bounds.

position.description: Absolute global scene index to scroll to (0-based). Must be >= 0 and < itemCount.

name: sceneBank_scrollBy
description: Scroll the scene bank by a relative amount. Positive values scroll forward (toward higher indices), negative values scroll backward. The bank window shifts by the specified amount.

amount.description: Number of positions to scroll. Positive = forward, negative = backward. Use bankSize (5) to scroll by one full page.

name: sceneBank_getScrollInfo
description: Get the current scroll state of the scene bank. Returns snapshot-backed cached values: scrollPosition (current offset), itemCount (total scenes in project), bankSize (window size, always 5), canScrollBackwards, canScrollForwards. Check canScrollForwards before scrolling to avoid no-ops.

name: cueMarkerBank_scrollTo
description: Scroll the cue marker bank to an absolute position. The position is a global cue marker index (not bank-relative). After scrolling, the bank window shows markers starting from this position. Returns POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE error if position is out of bounds.

position.description: Absolute global cue marker index to scroll to (0-based). Must be >= 0 and < itemCount.

name: cueMarkerBank_scrollBy
description: Scroll the cue marker bank by a relative amount. Positive values scroll forward, negative values scroll backward. The bank window shifts by the specified amount.

amount.description: Number of positions to scroll. Positive = forward, negative = backward. Use bankSize (16) to scroll by one full page.

name: cueMarkerBank_getScrollInfo
description: Get the current scroll state of the cue marker bank. Returns snapshot-backed cached values: scrollPosition, itemCount (total markers in project), bankSize (window size, always 16), canScrollBackwards, canScrollForwards.

name: trackBank_scrollTo
description: Scroll the track bank to an absolute position. The position is a global track index (not bank-relative). After scrolling, the bank window shows tracks starting from this position. Returns POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE error if position is out of bounds.

position.description: Absolute global track index to scroll to (0-based). Must be >= 0 and < itemCount.

name: trackBank_scrollBy
description: Scroll the track bank by a relative amount. Positive values scroll forward, negative values scroll backward. The bank window shifts by the specified amount.

amount.description: Number of positions to scroll. Positive = forward, negative = backward. Use bankSize (8) to scroll by one full page.

name: trackBank_getScrollInfo
description: Get the current scroll state of the track bank. Returns snapshot-backed cached values: scrollPosition, itemCount (total tracks in project), bankSize (window size, always 8), canScrollBackwards, canScrollForwards.

name: session_transaction
description: Execute a sequence of RPC operations atomically with stop-on-error semantics. Each operation is executed sequentially — if any step fails, execution stops immediately and partial results are returned. Use this to batch dependent calls (e.g., create clip then select it) where later steps should not run if earlier steps fail. Optionally capture state snapshots before and/or after execution, and optionally roll back completed steps on error via app/undo.

operations.description: Ordered list of RPC operations to execute. Each operation has a 'method' (RPC method name like 'clip/create') and optional 'params' (method parameters).

params.description: Parameters for the RPC method. Defaults to empty object if omitted.

preSnapshot.description: If true, capture a full state snapshot before executing any operations. Returned in the response as 'preSnapshot'. Default: false.

postSnapshot.description: If true, capture a full state snapshot after all operations complete (or after the last successful step on error). Returned in the response as 'postSnapshot'. Default: false.

rollback.description: If set to 'undoAll' and an error occurs, call app/undo N times for N successfully completed steps (best-effort). The response includes rollback info: { rolledBack: true, undoCount: N }.

name: macro_createTrack
description: Create a new track with optional rename, color, device insertion, and sound design in a single call. Composes track/create + track/rename + track/setColor + device/insertBitwigDevice + macro/createSound. Use instead of calling these methods separately.

name.description: Name to assign to the new track. If omitted, the track keeps its default name.

position.description: 0-based insert position. -1 or omitted = append at end.

device.description: Name of a Bitwig built-in device to insert on the new track (e.g., 'Polymer', 'Drum Machine'). Case-insensitive. Mutually exclusive with 'plugin'.

plugin.description: Third-party plugin device to insert. Mutually exclusive with 'device'.

id.description: Plugin identifier. VST2: numeric string. VST3: GUID string. CLAP: reverse-domain string (e.g., 'com.vendor.synth').

color.description: Track color as RGB floats (0.0 to 1.0). Applied after rename, before device insertion.

pages.description: Parameter pages to apply to the inserted device (requires 'device'). Same format as macro/createSound pages. Device parameters are set after a flush cycle to allow initialization.

params.description: Parameters to set on this page.

index.description: Parameter index within the page (0-7).

name: macro_createClip
description: Create an empty clip and select it (cursor clip ready for note writing) in a single call. Composes clip/create + clip/select. Use instead of calling these 2 methods separately.

lengthBeats.description: Clip length in beats (e.g., 16 for 4 bars in 4/4).

name: macro_writeClip
description: Create a clip, select it, set step size, and write notes in a single call. Composes clip/create + clip/select + clip/setStepSize + clip/setNotes + optional clip/rename. Returns { count } with the number of notes (optimistic — note writes are deferred to next flush cycle). To verify notes were actually written, call clip/getNotes after a 1-2 second delay.

lengthBeats.description: Clip length in beats (e.g., 16 for 4 bars in 4/4).

notes.description: Array of note objects to write.

expressions.description: Per-note expression values. Each key is a property name, value is 0.0–1.0.

mask.description: Bitmask for active steps in cycle.

name: macro_buildSection
description: Build a song section: create/rename a scene and write clips across multiple tracks. If sceneIndex is provided, uses that existing scene slot directly (recommended after manual scene creation or bulk deletion). If omitted, auto-creates a new scene (may fail if scene count cache is stale). Returns { sceneIndex, clipCount } (optimistic — note writes are deferred across multiple flush cycles). To verify, use clip/select + clip/getNotes on individual clips after a few seconds.

sceneIndex.description: Optional bank-relative scene slot index (0–4). If provided, skips scene creation and uses this slot directly. The scene must already exist and be visible in the current scene bank window. Recommended after manual scene creation or bulk deletion.

clips.description: Array of clip definitions, one per track.

notes.description: Array of note objects. Supports optional expression properties.

expressions.description: Per-note expressions {pan, timbre, pressure, gain, transpose, releaseVelocity, velocitySpread, mute}.

name: macro_setupScenes
description: Create and rename multiple scenes in one call, with each rename deferred to a separate flush cycle to avoid Bitwig's scene bank re-indexing bug (ISS-006). Use this instead of calling scene/create + scene/rename in a loop. Returns { created, renamed } (renamed count is optimistic — renames are deferred).

scenes.description: Array of scene definitions. Each scene will be created (in order) then renamed in a separate flush cycle.

index.description: Bank-relative scene index (0–4) to rename. Must match the position the scene will occupy after creation.

name: macro_createSound
description: Create a sound from scratch in one call. Optionally inserts a Bitwig device or third-party plugin, then batch-sets parameters across multiple pages. If 'device' or 'plugin' is provided, the device is inserted first and parameter setting is deferred one flush cycle for initialization. If neither is provided, parameters are applied immediately to the currently selected device (reshape mode). Returns { ok, device, pageCount, paramCount, inserted }.

device.description: Bitwig device name to insert (e.g., 'Polymer'). Mutually exclusive with 'plugin'. Omit both to apply parameters to the currently selected device.

plugin.description: Third-party plugin device to insert. Mutually exclusive with 'device'.

position.description: Where to insert the device in the chain. Default: 'end'.

pages.description: Array of page objects, each with pageIndex and params to set on that page.

params.description: Parameters to set on this page.

index.description: Parameter index within the page (0-7).

name: macro_buildSong
description: Build an entire song structure in one call: create multiple tracks with devices and sound parameters, then build sections with clips. Chains macro/createTrack and macro/buildSection internally with proper flush delays between each track to prevent cursor race conditions. Tracks are created sequentially; sections are built after all tracks complete. Returns { trackCount, sectionCount }.

tracks.description: Array of track definitions. Each track is created sequentially with proper timing.

device.description: Bitwig device to insert. Mutually exclusive with 'plugin'.

plugin.description: Third-party plugin to insert. Mutually exclusive with 'device'.

pages.description: Sound parameter pages (same format as macro/createSound).

sections.description: Array of section definitions. Each section is built after all tracks complete. Uses macro/buildSection format.

sceneIndex.description: Optional explicit scene index. If omitted, a new scene is created.

clips.description: Clips to write in this section.

notes.description: Notes to write. Supports optional expression properties.

name: macro_writeAutomation
description: Write arranger automation envelopes for multiple device parameters in one call. Automatically enables arranger automation write, handles page switching for multi-page parameters, and chains envelope writes sequentially. Delegates to device/writeEnvelope internally. Returns { ok, envelopeCount, totalPoints } (optimistic — envelope writes are deferred).

envelopes.description: Array of envelope definitions, one per parameter.

paramIndex.description: Remote control parameter index (0–7) on the target page.

pageIndex.description: Optional remote controls page index. If omitted, writes to the current page.

position.description: Beat position in the arrangement (0.0 = start).

name: app_activateEngine
description: Activate the Bitwig audio engine. Use when the engine has been deactivated and needs to be restarted.

name: app_deactivateEngine
description: Deactivate the Bitwig audio engine. Stops all audio processing. Use for troubleshooting audio issues.

name: app_showNotification
description: Show a temporary popup notification in Bitwig Studio's UI. Useful for communicating status or completion to the user.

name: app_setPanelLayout
description: Switch Bitwig Studio's panel layout. Valid layouts: ARRANGE, MIX, EDIT.

name: app_toggleInspector
description: Toggle the visibility of the inspector panel in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_toggleDevices
description: Toggle the visibility of the device chain panel in Bitwig Studio. Use this to show or hide the device panel without changing the panel layout.

name: app_toggleMixer
description: Toggle the visibility of the mixer panel in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_toggleNoteEditor
description: Toggle the visibility of the note editor (piano roll) panel in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_toggleAutomationEditor
description: Toggle the visibility of the automation editor panel in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_toggleBrowser
description: Toggle the visibility of the browser panel in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_toggleFullScreen
description: Toggle between full screen and windowed mode in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_previousSubPanel
description: Switch to the previous detail sub-panel (cycles between note editor, device, automation).

name: app_nextSubPanel
description: Switch to the next detail sub-panel (cycles between note editor, device, automation).

name: project_unsoloAll
description: Unsolo all tracks in the project. Clears all solo states at once.

name: project_unmuteAll
description: Unmute all tracks in the project. Clears all mute states at once.

name: project_unarmAll
description: Disarm all tracks in the project. Clears all record-arm states at once.

name: project_getState
description: Get project-wide state: hasSoloedTracks, hasMutedTracks, hasArmedTracks, isModified. Use to check if any tracks are soloed/muted/armed, or if the project has unsaved changes.

name: transport_continuePlayback
description: Continue playback from the current position. Unlike transport_play which resets to the play-start position, this resumes from where playback was stopped.

name: transport_restart
description: Restart playback from the play-start position. Equivalent to stopping and then playing.

name: transport_returnToArrangement
description: Return to the arrangement from clip launcher playback. Restores arranger timeline control after clip launcher clips have overridden track playback.

name: transport_jumpToPreviousCueMarker
description: Jump the playback position to the previous cue marker. Complements cue marker creation/editing in the arranger handler.

name: transport_jumpToNextCueMarker
description: Jump the playback position to the next cue marker. Complements cue marker creation/editing in the arranger handler.

name: transport_setPreRoll
description: Set the pre-roll (count-in) mode for recording. Valid values: none, one_bar, two_bars, four_bars.

name: transport_setMetronomeVolume
description: Set the metronome (click) volume. Value is normalized 0.0 to 1.0.

name: browser_browsePresets
description: Open the Bitwig browser for preset replacement on the currently selected device. The browser must be opened before using navigation methods (selectNextFile, selectPreviousFile, etc.). After browsing, use browser_commit to load the selected preset or browser_cancel to close without changes.

name: browser_browseInsertDevice
description: Open the Bitwig browser for inserting a new device after the currently selected device. After browsing, use browser_commit to insert the selected device or browser_cancel to close without changes.

name: browser_selectNextFile
description: Select the next result in the browser. The browser must be open (via browser_browsePresets or browser_browseInsertDevice) for this to have any effect. Result name updates after ~500ms delay.

name: browser_selectPreviousFile
description: Select the previous result in the browser. The browser must be open for this to have any effect.

name: browser_selectFirstFile
description: Jump to the first result in the browser. The browser must be open for this to have any effect.

name: browser_selectLastFile
description: Jump to the last result in the browser. The browser must be open for this to have any effect.

name: browser_commit
description: Commit the current browser selection — loads the selected preset or inserts the selected device. Closes the browser after committing.

name: browser_cancel
description: Cancel the browser and close it without applying any selection.

name: browser_setContentType
description: Switch the browser content type tab by index. Content types vary by context (e.g., Devices, Presets, Samples).

index.description: Zero-based index of the content type to select.

name: browser_setShouldAudition
description: Enable or disable audition mode in the browser. When enabled, selecting a preset will preview it in place.

enabled.description: True to enable audition, false to disable.

name: browser_getState
description: Get the current browser state: exists (whether browser is open), title, selectedContentType, contentTypeNames, canAudition, shouldAudition, resultName (currently highlighted result), resultIsSelected.

name: browser_filterSelectNext
description: Select the next filter item in the specified column. The browser must be open for this to have effect.

name: browser_filterSelectPrevious
description: Select the previous filter item in the specified column.

name: browser_filterSelectFirst
description: Jump to the first filter item in the specified column.

name: browser_filterSelectLast
description: Jump to the last filter item in the specified column.

name: browser_filterSelectParent
description: Navigate to the parent item in a hierarchical filter column (e.g., move from a subcategory to its parent category).

name: browser_filterSelectFirstChild
description: Navigate to the first child item in a hierarchical filter column (e.g., expand a category to see its subcategories).

name: browser_filterReset
description: Reset the specified filter column to the wildcard (All/Any) item, clearing any active filter selection.

name: browser_getFilters
description: Get the current state of all 8 filter columns. Returns per-column: exists (boolean), name (current filter cursor item), hitCount (results matching this filter), entryCount (total filter entries).

name: browser_getResults
description: Get the current result bank state — 8 visible result items with name and isSelected, plus total entryCount. Use browser_scrollResults to page through results.

name: browser_scrollResults
description: Scroll the result bank window. Use to page through browser results when more than 8 items exist.

name: clip_setLaunchQuantization
description: Set the launch quantization for the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Controls how the clip aligns to the grid when launched.

name: clip_setLaunchMode
description: Set the launch mode for the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Controls playback behavior when the clip is launched.

name: clip_setShuffle
description: Enable or disable shuffle (swing) for the currently selected clip (cursor clip).

enabled.description: Whether shuffle is enabled.

name: clip_setAccent
description: Set the accent amount for the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Controls velocity emphasis.

name: clip_setUseLoopStartAsQuantizationReference
description: Set whether the clip uses loop start as quantization reference ("Q to loop" in Bitwig inspector) for the currently selected clip.

enabled.description: Whether to use loop start as quantization reference.

name: clip_getLaunchSettings
description: Get all launch settings for the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Returns launchQuantization, launchMode, shuffle, accent, and useLoopStartAsQuantizationReference.

name: transport_setDefaultLaunchQuantization
description: Set the global default launch quantization for the clip launcher. Affects all clips that use "default" quantization.

quantization.description: Default launch quantization value. Note: "default" is not valid here — this IS the default.

name: transport_setPostRecordingAction
description: Set what happens after recording a clip in the clip launcher.

name: transport_setPostRecordingTimeOffset
description: Set the post-recording time offset in beats. Controls how long after the recording point the post-recording action triggers.

name: transport_setClipLauncherOverdub
description: Enable or disable clip launcher overdub mode. When enabled, recording into an existing clip adds notes instead of replacing.

enabled.description: Whether overdub is enabled.

name: transport_setFillMode
description: Enable or disable fill mode. When active, fill clips play instead of regular clips.

enabled.description: Whether fill mode is active.

name: transport_getClipLauncherSettings
description: Get all clip launcher settings from the transport. Returns defaultLaunchQuantization, clipLauncherPostRecordingAction, clipLauncherPostRecordingTimeOffset, clipLauncherOverdubEnabled, and fillModeActive.

name: clip_setColor
description: Set the color of a clip launcher slot. Uses RGB values normalized to 0.0–1.0.

name: clip_setPlayStart
description: Set the play start position of the currently selected clip (cursor clip) in beats.

name: clip_setPlayStop
description: Set the play stop position of the currently selected clip (cursor clip) in beats.

name: clip_setLoopStart
description: Set the loop start position of the currently selected clip (cursor clip) in beats.

name: clip_setLoopLength
description: Set the loop length of the currently selected clip (cursor clip) in beats.

name: clip_setLoopEnabled
description: Enable or disable looping for the currently selected clip (cursor clip).

enabled.description: Whether looping is enabled.

name: clip_getPlaybackSettings
description: Get playback settings for the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Returns playStart, playStop, loopStart, loopLength, and isLoopEnabled.

name: clip_quantize
description: Quantize the notes in the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Applies a morph quantization — amount controls how far notes move toward the grid.

amount.description: Quantize amount (0.0 = no change, 1.0 = fully on grid).

name: clip_transpose
description: Transpose all notes in the currently selected clip (cursor clip) by a number of semitones.

semitones.description: Number of semitones to transpose (positive = up, negative = down).

name: clip_duplicateContent
description: Duplicate the content of the currently selected clip (cursor clip). Doubles the clip length and repeats the notes.

name: clip_showInEditor
description: Show a clip launcher slot in Bitwig's detail editor panel.

name: clip_launchAlt
description: Launch a clip using the alternative launch action (configured in Bitwig preferences).

name: clip_launchRelease
description: Trigger the launch release action for a clip (simulates releasing the launch button).

name: clip_launchReleaseAlt
description: Trigger the alternative launch release action for a clip.

name: scene_setColor
description: Set the color of a scene. Uses RGB values normalized to 0.0–1.0.

index.description: Scene index (0-4) within the current scene bank window.

name: scene_launchAlt
description: Launch a scene using the alternative launch action (configured in Bitwig preferences).

index.description: Scene index (0-4) within the current scene bank window.

name: scene_launchRelease
description: Trigger the launch release action for a scene (simulates releasing the launch button).

index.description: Scene index (0-4) within the current scene bank window.

name: scene_launchReleaseAlt
description: Trigger the alternative launch release action for a scene.

index.description: Scene index (0-4) within the current scene bank window.

name: noteInput_sendNote
description: Send a note-on or note-off event via the NoteInput for real-time MIDI playback. velocity=0 sends note-off. Notes are injected directly into the selected track's instrument.

name: noteInput_sendMidi
description: Send a raw MIDI event via the NoteInput. Use for CC, pitch bend, aftertouch, or any MIDI message. For notes, prefer noteInput_sendNote.

status.description: MIDI status byte (e.g., 0x90 for note-on ch1, 0xB0 for CC ch1, 0xE0 for pitch bend ch1).

name: arpeggiator_configure
description: Batch-configure arpeggiator properties. All parameters are optional — only provided values are changed. Use with arpeggiator_setEnabled to activate.

gateLength.description: Note length as ratio of the period (1/32 to 8).

isFreeRunning.description: If true, arpeggiator does not sync to transport.

usePressureToVelocity.description: Use note pressure to determine arpeggio velocity.

terminateNotesImmediately.description: If true, notes stop immediately on release rather than playing to their computed end.

name: arpeggiator_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable the arpeggiator. When enabled, held notes are transformed into rhythmic patterns based on the configured mode and rate.

enabled.description: True to enable, false to disable.

name: arpeggiator_releaseNotes
description: Release all notes currently held by the arpeggiator. Stops any playing arpeggiated pattern.

name: arpeggiator_getState
description: Get the current arpeggiator state: isEnabled, mode, octaves, rate, gateLength, shuffle, humanize, isFreeRunning, enableOverlappingNotes, usePressureToVelocity, terminateNotesImmediately.

name: noteLatch_configure
description: Batch-configure note latch properties. All parameters are optional — only provided values are changed. Use with noteLatch_setEnabled to activate.

mono.description: If true, only one note is latched at a time.

velocityThreshold.description: Velocity threshold for the velocity latch mode.

name: noteLatch_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable note latch. When enabled, notes sustain after release based on the latch mode (chord, toggle, or velocity).

enabled.description: True to enable, false to disable.

name: noteLatch_releaseNotes
description: Release all notes currently held by the note latch. Stops any sustained notes.

name: noteLatch_getState
description: Get the current note latch state: isEnabled, mode, mono, velocityThreshold, activeNotes.

name: device_enterLayer
description: Navigate the device cursor into a nested layer's device chain. Used for Instrument Layer, FX Layer, and similar layered devices. Provide either index or name (not both). Use device_exitToParent to return.

index.description: Layer index (0-based). Mutually exclusive with name.

name.description: Layer name. Mutually exclusive with index.

name: device_enterKeyPad
description: Navigate the device cursor into a drum pad's device chain by MIDI key. Used for Drum Machine to access per-pad instruments and FX. Use device_exitToParent to return.

key.description: MIDI note number (0-127) associated with the drum pad. Common: 36=kick, 38=snare, 42=hihat.

name: device_selectPageByTag
description: Jump to a parameter page by tag instead of cycling sequentially. Tags are assigned by device developers to categorize pages (e.g., oscillator pages tagged 'osc', filter pages tagged 'filter').

cycle.description: Wrap around when reaching the end. Default: true.

name: device_discoverAll
description: Initiate a full parameter discovery scan of the currently selected device. Cycles through every parameter page (100ms per page) and collects all parameter names, values, and displayed values. Returns immediately with { scanning: true, pageCount, estimatedMs }. Call device_getDiscoveryResult after the estimated time to retrieve the complete parameter map. The original page is restored after scanning.

name: device_getDiscoveryResult
description: Retrieve the result of a device/discoverAll scan. By default returns the full parameter map: { deviceName, pageCount, pages: [{ index, name, parameters: [{ index, name, value, displayedValue }] }] }. With format='preset', returns macro/createSound-compatible JSON: { deviceName, pageCount, pages: [{ pageIndex, params: [{ index, value }] }] }. If the scan is still in progress, returns { scanning: true }. Throws an error if no discovery has been initiated.

format.description: Output format: 'full' (default) for complete parameter map with names and displayed values, or 'preset' for macro/createSound-compatible JSON with just pageIndex/params.

name: masterDevice_enterLayer
description: Navigate the master device cursor into a nested layer's device chain. Same as device_enterLayer but for master bus devices.

index.description: Layer index (0-based). Mutually exclusive with name.

name.description: Layer name. Mutually exclusive with index.

name: masterDevice_enterKeyPad
description: Navigate the master device cursor into a drum pad's device chain by MIDI key. Same as device_enterKeyPad but for master bus devices.

key.description: MIDI note number (0-127) associated with the drum pad.

name: masterDevice_selectPageByTag
description: Jump to a parameter page by tag on the master device. Same as device_selectPageByTag but for master bus devices.

cycle.description: Wrap around when reaching the end. Default: true.

name: groove_getState
description: Get the current state of the global groove engine. Returns enabled (boolean), shuffleAmount, shuffleRate, accentAmount, accentRate, accentPhase (all 0.0–1.0). Groove applies swing/shuffle to all clips globally.

name: groove_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable the global groove engine. When enabled, shuffle and accent settings affect all clip playback.

enabled.description: True to enable groove, false to disable.

name: groove_setParameter
description: Set a groove parameter by name. Valid names: shuffleAmount, shuffleRate, accentAmount, accentRate, accentPhase. All values are 0.0–1.0.

name: track_toggleSolo
description: Toggle solo state on a track. When exclusive is true, all other tracks are unsoloed first (exclusive solo). When exclusive is false or omitted, only this track's solo is toggled.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

exclusive.description: If true, unsolo all other tracks (exclusive solo). Default: false.

name: app_zoomIn
description: Zoom in on the arranger/editor timeline.

name: app_zoomOut
description: Zoom out on the arranger/editor timeline.

name: app_zoomToFit
description: Zoom the arranger/editor to fit all content in the visible area.

name: app_zoomToSelection
description: Zoom the arranger/editor to fit the current selection in the visible area.

name: app_navigateIntoTrackGroup
description: Navigate Bitwig Studio into a track group (folder). This changes the visible scope to show only the tracks inside the group.

trackIndex.description: The index of the group track to navigate into (0-based within the current track bank).

name: app_navigateToParentTrackGroup
description: Navigate Bitwig Studio out of the current track group back to the parent level.

name: action_list
description: List all available Bitwig Studio actions (menu commands, keyboard shortcuts). Returns an array of {id, name, category, menuItemText} objects. Use the optional category filter to narrow results. Action IDs can be passed to action_invoke to trigger any Bitwig command programmatically.

category.description: Optional category name to filter actions (e.g. 'Edit', 'View'). Omit to list all actions.

name: action_listCategories
description: List all action categories in Bitwig Studio. Returns an array of {id, name} objects. Use category names with action_list to filter actions by category.

name: action_invoke
description: Invoke a Bitwig Studio action by its unique ID. This is a generic escape hatch that can trigger any menu command or keyboard shortcut. Use action_list to discover available action IDs first.

id.description: The unique action identifier (e.g. 'select_all', 'duplicate'). Get IDs from action_list.

name: detailEditor_zoomIn
description: Zoom in on the detail editor (note editor) timeline horizontally.

name: detailEditor_zoomOut
description: Zoom out on the detail editor (note editor) timeline horizontally.

name: detailEditor_zoomToFit
description: Zoom the detail editor to fit all content in the visible area.

name: detailEditor_zoomToSelection
description: Zoom the detail editor to fit the current selection in the visible area.

name: detailEditor_zoomToFitSelectionOrAll
description: Toggle the detail editor zoom between fitting the selection and fitting all content.

name: detailEditor_zoomInLanes
description: Zoom in on the detail editor lane heights (vertical zoom — makes note lanes taller).

name: detailEditor_zoomOutLanes
description: Zoom out on the detail editor lane heights (vertical zoom — makes note lanes shorter).

name: detailEditor_zoomToRegion
description: Zoom the detail editor to show a specific time region. Useful for framing a particular section of a clip.

from.description: Start position of the region (in beats).

to.description: End position of the region (in beats).

name: device_setParameterMapping
description: Toggle mapping mode for a remote control parameter slot. When enabled, the user can click a device parameter in Bitwig to assign it to this remote control slot.

index.description: Remote control parameter index (0-7).

enabled.description: true to enter mapping mode, false to exit.

name: device_getParameterMapping
description: Get the mapping mode state of all 8 remote control parameters. Returns an array of 8 booleans indicating which parameters are currently in mapping mode.

name: masterDevice_setParameterMapping
description: Toggle mapping mode for a master device remote control parameter slot.

index.description: Remote control parameter index (0-7).

enabled.description: true to enter mapping mode, false to exit.

name: masterDevice_getParameterMapping
description: Get the mapping mode state of all 8 master device remote control parameters.

name: note_scrollToKey
description: Scroll the note editor vertically to center on a specific MIDI key/note.

key.description: MIDI key number (0-127). Middle C is 60.

name: note_scrollKeysPageUp
description: Scroll the note editor one page up (higher pitch).

name: note_scrollKeysPageDown
description: Scroll the note editor one page down (lower pitch).

name: note_scrollKeysStepUp
description: Scroll the note editor one step up (one semitone higher).

name: note_scrollKeysStepDown
description: Scroll the note editor one step down (one semitone lower).

name: state_subscribe
description: Subscribe to specific state change topics on the WebSocket connection. Only deltas for subscribed topics will be sent. Must be called over WebSocket (not HTTP). Default is all topics.

topics.description: Array of topic names to subscribe to. Valid topics: transport, tracks, scenes, device, clip, master, application, arranger, arrangement, masterDevice, browser, arpeggiator, noteLatch, groove.

name: state_unsubscribe
description: Remove topics from the current WebSocket subscription. Must be called over WebSocket.

topics.description: Array of topic names to unsubscribe from.

name: state_subscribeAll
description: Reset WebSocket subscription to receive all state change topics (default behavior). Must be called over WebSocket.

name: state_getTopics
description: List all valid subscription topic names. Can be called over HTTP or WebSocket.

name: mixer_getState
description: Get the visibility state of all mixer panel sections. Returns 6 booleans: meter, io, sends, clipLauncher, devices, crossFade.

name: mixer_setSection
description: Show or hide a mixer panel section. Valid sections: meter, io, sends, clipLauncher, devices, crossFade.

visible.description: True to show the section, false to hide.

name: mixer_zoomInAll
description: Zoom in (widen) all mixer track strips.

name: mixer_zoomOutAll
description: Zoom out (narrow) all mixer track strips.

name: mixer_zoomInSelected
description: Zoom in (widen) the selected mixer track strips only.

name: mixer_zoomOutSelected
description: Zoom out (narrow) the selected mixer track strips only.

name: track_selectInMixer
description: Select a track in the Bitwig mixer panel, focusing the mixer on that channel strip.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

name: track_makeVisibleInMixer
description: Scroll the mixer panel so that the specified track becomes visible.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

name: cursor_selectParent
description: Move the cursor track selection to the parent group track. If already at root level, has no effect.

name: cursor_selectFirstChild
description: Move the cursor track selection to the first child track within the current group. Only works when cursor is on a group track.

name: cursor_setPinned
description: Pin or unpin the cursor track. When pinned, the cursor stays on the current track even if the user selects a different track in the Bitwig UI. Useful for batch operations.

pinned.description: True to pin the cursor, false to unpin.

name: cursor_getInfo
description: Get information about the current cursor track: name, trackType, and isPinned state.

name: track_getVuMeters
description: Poll the current VU meter levels (RMS sum) for all 8 tracks in the track bank. Returns an array of 8 integers (0-127). Call on demand for mixing analysis — not included in session_snapshot to avoid noise.

name: track_getPlayingNotes
description: Poll the currently playing MIDI notes on a specific track. Returns an array of {pitch, velocity} objects. Empty array when no notes are playing. Call on demand — not included in session_snapshot.

index.description: Track index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: project_setCueVolume
description: Set the cue/headphone monitoring volume (0.0–1.0). Controls the level of the cue mix output for headphone monitoring.

name: project_setCueMix
description: Set the cue mix balance (0.0–1.0). Controls the blend between the main mix and the cue/solo signal in headphone monitoring. 0.0 = all main mix, 1.0 = all cue.

name: arranger_zoomInLanes
description: Zoom in (enlarge) all track lane heights in the arranger.

name: arranger_zoomOutLanes
description: Zoom out (shrink) all track lane heights in the arranger.

name: arranger_zoomInSelectedLanes
description: Zoom in (enlarge) only the selected track lane heights in the arranger.

name: arranger_zoomOutSelectedLanes
description: Zoom out (shrink) only the selected track lane heights in the arranger.

name: arranger_zoomToRegion
description: Zoom the arranger timeline to show a specific beat range. Use this to frame a particular section (e.g., bars 17-24 for a chorus).

name: arranger_zoomToFitSelectionOrAll
description: Toggle the arranger zoom between fitting the current selection and fitting all content.
